# singlestoredb_clusters (Data Source)

This data source provides a list of clusters that the user has access to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "singlestoredb" {
  // The SingleStoreDB Terraform provider uses the SINGLESTOREDB_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
  // Please set this environment variable with your SingleStore Management API key.
  // You can generate this key from the SingleStore Portal at https://portal.singlestore.com/organizations/org-id/api-keys.
}

data "singlestoredb_clusters" "all" {
}

output "all_clusters" {
  value = data.singlestoredb_clusters.all
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `include_terminated` (Boolean) Whether to include terminated clusters in the result. Defaults to false.
- `project_id` (String) Filter clusters by project ID.

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `auto_scale` (Attributes) Autoscale settings for the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters--auto_scale))
- `auto_suspend` (Attributes) Auto suspend settings for the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters--auto_suspend))
- `cache_config` (Number) The cache config multiplier of the cluster.
- `cloud_provider` (String) The cloud provider of the cluster.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the cluster was created.
- `deployment_type` (String) The deployment type of the cluster.
- `endpoint` (String) The endpoint used to connect to the cluster.
- `expires_at` (String) The expiration timestamp of the cluster.
- `firewall_ranges` (List of String) List of allowed CIDR ranges.
- `group_id` (String) The unique identifier of the workspace group that contains the cluster.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the cluster.
- `kai` (Boolean) Whether SingleStore Kai is enabled for the cluster.
- `multi_az` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is deployed across multiple availability zones.
- `name` (String) The name of the cluster.
- `opt_in_preview_feature` (Boolean) Whether preview features are enabled.
- `outbound_allow_list` (String) The outbound allow list identifier (AWS only).
- `region_name` (String) The region code of the cluster.
- `scale_factor` (Number) The scale factor of the cluster.
- `size` (String) The size of the cluster, specified in workspace size notation (S-00, S-0, S-1, S-2).
- `state` (String) The state of the cluster. Possible values are ACTIVE, FAILED, PENDING, SUSPENDED, TERMINATED, UNKNOWN.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether the cluster is suspended.
- `update_window` (Attributes) The scheduled update window for the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters--update_window))
